summary: Family is thanked with one small, funny or tender detail instead of a list.
realLife: Four winners turn the thanks to family into a joke or a small story: a daughter and a clean room, pets and impeachments, a household of ten, a sleep joke for staff.

inGame: people records (household, spouse, children, parents) the speaker already has; needs: a trait-led small fact about a family member that a line can name

turns.way: The family thanks is plain, with no joke or story.
The family is not named because the speaker lives alone.
turns.pulledBy: no household on the person record
turns.writes: the thanks go to friends and the team
